A Xone, Phone, Traktor X1 and a dream

September 9, 2026

I wanted to add digital tracks and effects to my vinyl setup without bringing a laptop. This project explores using an Android phone, a Xone:96, and a Traktor X1 together, with access to the USB music library I already prepare for DJing. It’s a work in progress, built on Mixxx with help from Codex.

Better write-up coming soon.

Follow the project on GitHub.
